articles.title: Visa backs Open USD with new stablecoin platform as Circle faces fresh competition
articles.snippet: Visa launched a stablecoin platform that lets banks and fintechs issue, manage and settle digital dollars through its payments network.

articles.title: The most popular bitcoin call option has slipped by $10,000
Inside the high-stakes race to build an open financial system specifically for AI bots
articles.snippet: The newly-convened x402 Foundation is a neutral space where competitors and payment methods can work together to create an open standard for AI agentic commerce.

articles.title: U.S. Senate unanimously opposes clemency for FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried
articles.snippet: The nonbinding resolution passed without objection after Bankman-Fried asked for clemency, months after Trump pardoned other major crypto figures, including Changpeng Zhao and Ross Ulbricht.

articles.title: Gambling on random Pokémon cards: Onchain gagcha hits record high as crypto sinks
articles.snippet: Users spent a record $324 million on onchain gacha in June, even as Bitcoin hit a 21-month low. The thrill of scoring a top Pokemon card from a random pack is becoming big business
